name: fabric bandage
description: a fabric adhesive bandage wrapped around the left forearm, covering a nasty purple bruise from a string slap during archery. it's wrapped tight and clean.

params.message: the bandage covers a bruise from a bowstring slap. stupid mistake — you flinched on the release. it's healing but still tender.
you carefully unwrap the bandage. the bruise beneath is an ugly yellow-purple. it's healing.
